scope: Read-only correlation of regulation-side coding-plug objects with GFA P90/P100-P108.
correlations: 0x7656 contains 20 15 02 01; the values 15, 01 and 02 recur in P101, P102 and P107 respectively.
Exact byte-position mapping of the four 0x7656 source fields is still unresolved, so the repeated values are evidence of correlation, not yet a field-by-field identity proof.
P103/P104/P105 are source-labelled day/month/year. Direct numeric interpretation gives 20/12/4; BCD interpretation gives 14/12/04. Encoding/year-base remains unresolved.
P106=0xD6 remains a CRC diagnostic value; no checksum algorithm is claimed.

physical_spare_chip1_comparison.interpretation: No simple contiguous 1:1 copy of the active GFA vector is present in either captured spare chip1 image. This does not assign EEPROM domain or exclude transformed/mirrored storage.

mirror_literal_candidates.note: These are literal byte coincidences at corresponding offsets in the duplicated 82-byte record. They are candidate correlations only, not field assignments.

correlations_exact_cross_view.interpretation: Strong hardware correlation between the regulation/coding-card and GFA coding-plug identity views. Exact source byte-position semantics for the four 0x7656 subfields remain to be recovered before declaring a formal field mapping.
